# Main component — Milepost firmware for the Waveshare
# ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-7B.
#
# ui/*.c are generated by EEZ Studio (Ctrl+B on the .eez-project). Every
# ui_font_*.c and ui_image_*.c the export emits is swept in via GLOB.
# The core files (screens.c / styles.c / images.c / ui.c) only exist AFTER
# the export runs — before that, the __has_include guards in shared source
# (main.c, vars.c, actions.c, app_state.c) collapse the UI symbols to
# placeholders so the project still links to a boot-clean state.
file(GLOB UI_FONT_SRCS  "ui/ui_font_*.c")
file(GLOB UI_IMAGE_SRCS "ui/ui_image_*.c")
file(GLOB UI_CORE_SRCS  "ui/screens.c" "ui/styles.c" "ui/images.c" "ui/ui.c")

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        main.c
        actions.c
        alarms.c
        app_state.c
        perf.c
        vars.c
        ota.c
        discovery.c
        wifi_config.c
        ${UI_CORE_SRCS}
        ${UI_FONT_SRCS}
        ${UI_IMAGE_SRCS}
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        .
        ui
        include
    REQUIRES
        driver
        esp_lcd
        esp_timer
        nvs_flash
        esp_wifi
        esp_http_server
        app_update
        esp_netif
        esp_app_format
        esp_event
        # LVGL — pinned to 8.4 to match the .eez-project's lvglVersion.
        lvgl__lvgl
        # Waveshare GT911 touch driver (published via ESP Component Registry).
        espressif__esp_lcd_touch_gt911
        # mDNS for OTA hostname resolution.
        espressif__mdns
        # TrailCurrent local components.
        can_common
        # Milepost-imported Milepost components.
        milepost_config
        wifi_setup
        button_config
)
